note: Roadmap to the platinum, built from the official trophy descriptions alone: which story chapters and missions, which collectibles and counts, in what order. Stages are ordered so nothing is missed; only Positive Mental Attitude is flagged missable, because it is the only trophy the published guides flag that way.

stages.note: Play Chapters 1 to 4 and the final mission. Keep a manual save from the start of every chapter — the game has no mission replay and no New Game Plus, so a chapter-start save is your only way back. Keep one untouched save from just before the final mission too.
stages.title: 1 · Play the story, save smart

stages.note: Do this DURING Chapter 1, before you move on: after Lucia is home, check the kitchen in the morning (a morning after the mission Down to Earth is the usual time). She heads out to the balcony of Jason's house to meditate — follow her and accept the optional task. It is gone once Chapter 1 ends. Bring your partner to the other meditation spots too: each outdoor spot should count twice.
stages.title: 2 · The one missable: Lucia's balcony meditation

stages.note: Finish the side strands: Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy and Tyrone each end in a finale trophy, Bret Vogel's hunting questline is Jason-only, and 8 stranger strands earn Strangers & Freaks. Andy's, Billy's and Tyrone's strands do NOT count toward Strangers & Freaks — they have their own trophies. Check the counter after each strand. Everything here stays available after the credits.
stages.title: 3 · Strangers and side strands

stages.note: The robbery set unlocks in Chapters 3 and 4: the Snap Gun from Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs opens jewelry robberies, and That's Where The Money Is (optional, near the end of Chapter 4) opens bank vaults. Rob a vault with your partner and Hot Together pops with Maximum Withdrawal. Every robbery trophy only pops once you are out of the red heat zone.
stages.title: 4 · Partner and robbery trophies

stages.note: The collectible set: 3 card sets, WAiNK at 100 locations, 100 vehicles discovered, all 52 areas of Leonida explored, all 8 garages bought, 10 vehicles registered. Buy the garages before registering cars — each registered car needs a free garage space. Scan traffic with the WAiNK app as you drive.
stages.title: 5 · Collectibles and exploration

stages.note: The long tail of activities, races and grinds: 250 stunts, 42 gold shooting-range medals, drone races at all 14 locations, 20 different race wins, fishing, arcade, 50 of the 80 challenges, Combat Focus, the VCIA plane, the Rhino tank, the Ocean Beach cocktail, the showroom smash, bowling, max Strength with both characters, 500 profile choices, $250,000 laundered and $100,000 spent. None of it is missable — it all stays open after the story.
stages.title: 6 · Activities, races and grinds

stages.note: Attain 100% Completion — the checklist appears after the story under Progress, then Stats, then 100% Completion, and earlier work counts. The thresholds go past the individual trophies: 300 stunts, 70 of 80 challenges, all 8 vaults, all 39 illegal operations, 200 of 277 vehicles. When A Long Road pops, the platinum follows: Vice Got a Price!
stages.title: 7 · 100% completion, then the platinum
